$Comment: A spot the quest tracker can sit at: the top left, below where the Activity ledger sits as
shipped, for a player who keeps the right side of the screen clear. Panels names
Quest_Tracker, which is how a spot is offered to the tracker at all. A player picks it under
Quest tracker on their Settings tab.
OffsetY is measured down from the top edge and is a starting point: where the ledger ends
depends on how many rows it shows and on a screen's own scale, so move it until the tracker
clears the ledger on your screen. Keep a Top preset: a spot pinning the tracker anywhere
else is not taken. Only Position is read for the tracker. LabelKey names the spot on the
Settings tab and Order is where it is listed, lower first.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Quest_Tracker_Left' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-spots.json with only the leaves you want different.
